summary: Munich, Germany, freelance consultant/support technician, coding for startups, strong anti-capitalist views, advocates for social justice and refugee rights, critical of US policies, supports public transport and renewable energy, interested in technology and programming, particularly PHP and web development, engaged in discussions about cryptocurrency and online privacy, critical of ad-blocking and internet regulations, expresses concern over immigration policies and treatment of asylum seekers, emphasizes the importance of education and rehabilitation in the justice system.
